package.name: Big Cheese
package.description: A game where you run any place as the boss: a warehouse, a school, a ward. You wish for the place, answer the cards your staff bring you, and see how the week went on Friday. Install it, restart Marinara Engine when prompted, then open Home → Big Cheese.
